source: 龙潭农场英语学习资料_词根词缀与蓝莓生产QA扩展版(1).xlsx

vocabulary.name: timesheet
vocabulary.example: Please complete your timesheet before leaving.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: time（时间）+ sheet（表/表格）组成的复合词。
vocabulary.memoryHint: 按“时间表”记：记录工时的表。

vocabulary.name: work category
vocabulary.morphologyNote: work（工作）+ category（类别）；category 是整体词，不建议硬拆词根。

vocabulary.name: labor hours
vocabulary.example: We need to verify the labor hours.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要核实人工工时。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: labor 指劳动/人工；hours 是 hour（小时）的复数。

vocabulary.name: piece rate
vocabulary.morphologyNote: piece（件/单件）+ rate（比率/单价）。

vocabulary.name: piecework
vocabulary.example: This task is paid by piecework.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: piece（件）+ work（工作）组成的复合词。

vocabulary.name: attendance record
vocabulary.morphologyNote: attend（出席）+ -ance（名词后缀，表示行为/状态）；record（记录）。

vocabulary.name: work order
vocabulary.morphologyNote: work（工作）+ order（指令/顺序）。

vocabulary.name: maintenance log
vocabulary.morphologyNote: maintain（维护）+ -ance（名词后缀，表示行为/过程）；log（日志）。

vocabulary.name: inspection checklist
vocabulary.morphologyNote: inspect（检查）+ -ion（名词后缀，表示行为/过程）；check + list。

vocabulary.name: supporting evidence
vocabulary.morphologyNote: support（支持）+ -ing；evidence（证据/佐证），整体记忆即可。
vocabulary.memoryHint: 支持某项记录或申请的材料。

vocabulary.name: approval
vocabulary.morphologyNote: approve（批准）+ -al（名词后缀），表示批准这件事/批准状态。
vocabulary.memoryHint: approval 是名词；approve 是动词。

vocabulary.name: workload
vocabulary.morphologyNote: work（工作）+ load（负荷/负担）。

vocabulary.name: record
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 同一拼写可作名词或动词；重音不同，意义随词性变化。

vocabulary.name: submit
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 来自拉丁语 submittere，现代学习时整体记忆更可靠；不是简单按字母拆义。

vocabulary.name: verify
vocabulary.example: Verify the hours with the supervisor.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 与 verus（真实）词源相关；verify 表示核实真伪/准确性。

vocabulary.name: allocate
vocabulary.translation: 把工人分配到不同任务。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 与 loc（place，位置）词根相关；allocate 有“分配到某处/某项”的含义。

vocabulary.name: classify
vocabulary.morphologyNote: class（类别）+ -ify（使成为/使变成）；分类。

vocabulary.name: approve
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 与 prove/proof（证明）词源相关；approve 表示认可/批准。

vocabulary.name: revise
vocabulary.morphologyNote: re-（再、重新）+ vise/vis（看，词源相关）；重新审视后修改。

vocabulary.name: duplicate
vocabulary.morphologyNote: du-/duo（两个）+ plic（折叠，词源相关）；duplicate 有复制/重复之意。
vocabulary.memoryHint: 重复录入；也可表示副本。

vocabulary.name: lawn mower
vocabulary.morphologyNote: lawn（草坪）+ mower（割草机）；mower 来自 mow（割草）+ -er（执行者/工具）。

vocabulary.name: sprayer
vocabulary.morphologyNote: spray（喷）+ -er（执行动作的人/设备）。

vocabulary.name: automatic sprayer
vocabulary.morphologyNote: automatic 与 automate/automation 同族；spray + -er。

vocabulary.name: automatic weeder
vocabulary.morphologyNote: weed（杂草/除草）+ -er（工具/执行者）。

vocabulary.name: forklift
vocabulary.morphologyNote: fork（叉）+ lift（举起）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: 叉车，字面是“叉起并举升”。

vocabulary.name: tricycle
vocabulary.morphologyNote: tri-（三）+ cycle（轮/环，词源相关）。

vocabulary.name: pressure washer
vocabulary.translation: 清洗高压清洗机过滤器。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: pressure（压力）+ washer（清洗设备；wash + -er）。

vocabulary.name: engine oil
vocabulary.morphologyNote: engine（发动机）+ oil（油）。

vocabulary.name: blade
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 整体记忆的基础名词，不建议硬拆词根。

vocabulary.name: fuel container
vocabulary.example: Take the fuel containers to the station.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: fuel（燃料）+ container（容器；contain + -er）。

vocabulary.name: gasoline
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 整体记忆的名词；不建议按 gas + line 解释。

vocabulary.name: diesel
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 来自发明者 Rudolf Diesel 的姓氏，属于人名来源。

vocabulary.name: inspect
vocabulary.morphologyNote: spect 词根表示“看”，如 spectacle；inspect 是仔细查看/检查。

vocabulary.name: repair
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 来自法语/拉丁语词源，现代初学者建议整体记忆。

vocabulary.name: replace
vocabulary.morphologyNote: re-（重新/替换）+ place（放置）；把旧件换成新件。

vocabulary.name: calibrate
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 与 caliber（规格/口径）同源；校准到标准值。

vocabulary.name: refuel
vocabulary.morphologyNote: re-（再次）+ fuel（燃料）；重新加燃料。

vocabulary.name: lubricate
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 与 lubricant（润滑剂）同词族；来自表示润滑/使光滑的拉丁词源。

vocabulary.name: irrigation system
vocabulary.morphologyNote: irrigate（灌溉）+ -ion（行为/过程名词后缀）。

vocabulary.name: mainline
vocabulary.morphologyNote: main（主要的）+ line（管线）。

vocabulary.name: lateral pipe
vocabulary.morphologyNote: lateral 表示侧面的/支线的；pipe（管）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: 支管；按农场内部叫法也可对应20管。

vocabulary.name: drip emitter
vocabulary.morphologyNote: drip（滴）+ emit（发出/释放）+ -er（设备）。

vocabulary.name: drip stake
vocabulary.morphologyNote: drip（滴灌）+ stake（插杆/桩）。

vocabulary.name: micro tubing
vocabulary.morphologyNote: micro-（微小）+ tubing（管材/软管；tube + -ing）。

vocabulary.name: filter
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 整体记忆的基础词；与 filtration（过滤）同词族。

vocabulary.name: filter disc
vocabulary.morphologyNote: filter（过滤器）+ disc（圆盘/碟片）。

vocabulary.name: pump house
vocabulary.morphologyNote: pump（水泵）+ house（房屋/机房）。

vocabulary.name: fertigation
vocabulary.morphologyNote: fertilizer（肥料）+ irrigation（灌溉）融合形成的术语。
vocabulary.memoryHint: 随灌溉施肥/水肥一体化。

vocabulary.name: solenoid valve
vocabulary.example: The solenoid valve is not opening.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: solenoid（电磁线圈/螺线管）+ valve（阀门）。

vocabulary.name: pressure gauge
vocabulary.morphologyNote: pressure（压力）+ gauge（测量仪表）。

vocabulary.name: flow rate
vocabulary.morphologyNote: flow（流动/流量）+ rate（速率）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: 流量/流速率，具体单位看测量口径。

vocabulary.name: uniformity test
vocabulary.morphologyNote: uniform（均匀的）+ -ity（性质/状态名词后缀）。

vocabulary.name: UV system
vocabulary.morphologyNote: UV 是 ultraviolet（紫外线）的缩写。

vocabulary.name: drainage pump
vocabulary.morphologyNote: drain（排水）+ -age（过程/结果名词后缀）。

vocabulary.name: nutrient solution
vocabulary.morphologyNote: nutrient 与 nutrition 同词族；solution 表示溶液。

vocabulary.name: flush
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 整体记忆的动词；在管路维护中指用水冲洗。

vocabulary.name: unclog
vocabulary.morphologyNote: un-（去除/反向）+ clog（堵塞）；解除堵塞。

vocabulary.name: leak
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 整体记忆的基础词。

vocabulary.name: measure
vocabulary.example: Measure the pressure at the end.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 整体记忆的动词；measurement 是测量结果/测量过程。

vocabulary.name: adjust
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 整体记忆；adjustment 是名词“调整”。

vocabulary.name: install
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 与 establish/installation 同词族；表示安装、设置到位。

vocabulary.name: clean
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 基础词；cleaning 是清洗/清洁。

vocabulary.name: greenhouse tunnel
vocabulary.morphologyNote: green + house；tunnel 指棚/隧道式结构。

vocabulary.name: ground cover fabric
vocabulary.example: The ground is covered with fabric.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: ground（地面）+ cover（覆盖）+ fabric（织物/布）。

vocabulary.name: substrate
vocabulary.morphologyNote: sub-（下面）+ stratum/层的词源相关；园艺中指栽培基质。

vocabulary.name: planting pot
vocabulary.morphologyNote: plant（种植）+ -ing；pot（盆）。

vocabulary.name: weed control
vocabulary.example: We need to schedule weed control.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: weed（杂草）+ control（控制）。

vocabulary.name: pesticide application
vocabulary.morphologyNote: pest（害物）+ -cide（杀灭）；apply（施用）+ -ation（名词后缀）。

vocabulary.name: bird netting
vocabulary.morphologyNote: bird（鸟）+ net（网）+ -ing。

vocabulary.name: plastic film
vocabulary.example: The plastic film has come loose.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: plastic（塑料）+ film（薄膜）。

vocabulary.name: spray
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 基础动词；sprayer（喷雾器）、spraying（喷施）同词族。

vocabulary.name: weed
vocabulary.example: We need to weed this area.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要清除这片区域的杂草。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 可作名词“杂草”，也可作动词“除草”。

vocabulary.name: secure
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 整体记忆；security（安全）同词族，secure 在此表示固定牢靠。
vocabulary.memoryHint: 固定松动的棚膜或部件。

vocabulary.name: document
vocabulary.morphologyNote: doc-/doct 词源与教导/证明相关；现代工作中 document 可作文件或记录。

vocabulary.name: yield
vocabulary.example: The yield is higher than last season.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 基础词，整体记忆；crop yield 指作物产量。
vocabulary.memoryHint: yield 是总产量或单位面积产量，需看上下文和单位。

vocabulary.name: production
vocabulary.example: We need to record the weekly production.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要记录每周产量。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: produce（生产）+ -tion（行为/结果名词后缀）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: production 可指生产过程，也可指产出量。

vocabulary.name: harvest
vocabulary.example: The harvest will peak next week.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 整体记忆；可作名词或动词。

vocabulary.name: harvest volume
vocabulary.example: Please update the harvest volume every day.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: harvest（采收）+ volume（数量/体积）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: volume 常用于数量、体积或业务量。

vocabulary.name: peak
vocabulary.example: The harvest peak is expected in December.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 基础词，整体记忆。

vocabulary.name: packout rate
vocabulary.example: We need to improve the packout rate.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要提高商品果率。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: pack（包装）+ out（产出）+ rate（比率）；行业用语，具体口径需按公司标准。
vocabulary.memoryHint: packout 的统计口径要与农场/包装厂定义一致。

vocabulary.name: harvest frequency
vocabulary.example: Harvest frequency may change with fruit maturity.
vocabulary.translation: 采收频次可能随果实成熟度变化。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: harvest（采收）+ frequency（频率）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: frequency 与 frequent（频繁的）同词族。

vocabulary.name: harvest record
vocabulary.example: Please check the harvest record by variety.
vocabulary.translation: 请按品种检查采收记录。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: harvest + record。

vocabulary.name: fruit quality
vocabulary.example: Fruit quality must be checked at harvest.
vocabulary.translation: 采收时必须检查果实品质。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: fruit（果实）+ quality（质量/品质）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: quality 可指品质，也可指质量水平。

vocabulary.name: firmness
vocabulary.example: Fruit firmness is an important quality indicator.
vocabulary.translation: 果实硬度是重要的品质指标。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: firm（坚实的）+ -ness（形容词变名词，表示性质/状态）。

vocabulary.name: soluble solids
vocabulary.example: We measure soluble solids in the sample.
vocabulary.translation: 我们测量样品的可溶性固形物。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: soluble（可溶的）+ solids（固形物复数）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: 常与 Brix 一起出现，具体检测方法按QA标准。

vocabulary.name: Brix
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 以 °Brix 表示的可溶性固形物读数，不能简单等同于纯糖含量。

vocabulary.name: acidity
vocabulary.example: We also need to check fruit acidity.
vocabulary.translation: 我们还需要检测果实酸度。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: acid（酸）+ -ity（性质/状态名词后缀）。

vocabulary.name: bloom
vocabulary.example: The berries should have an even bloom.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 基础词，原意也有花/开花；蓝莓品质语境中特指果粉。
vocabulary.memoryHint: blueberry bloom 指果实表面的天然蜡质果粉。

vocabulary.name: berry size
vocabulary.translation: 不同品种的果粒大小不同。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: berry（浆果）+ size（大小）。

vocabulary.name: cracking
vocabulary.example: We found some fruit cracking after rain.
vocabulary.translation: 雨后我们发现部分果实裂果。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: crack（裂开）+ -ing（动作/现象名词化）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: crack = 裂开；cracking = 裂果/开裂现象。

vocabulary.name: soft fruit
vocabulary.morphologyNote: soft（软的）+ fruit（果实）。

vocabulary.name: maturity
vocabulary.translation: 采收前检查果实成熟度。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: mature（成熟的）+ -ity（性质/状态名词后缀）。

vocabulary.name: quality assurance
vocabulary.example: Quality assurance starts in the field.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: quality（品质）+ assurance（保证；assure + -ance）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: QA 是 quality assurance 的缩写。

vocabulary.name: quality control
vocabulary.example: The QA team carries out quality control checks.
vocabulary.translation: QA团队开展质量控制检查。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: quality + control（控制）。

vocabulary.name: sample
vocabulary.translation: 取一个有代表性的果实样品。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 整体记忆的基础词，可作名词或动词。

vocabulary.name: sampling
vocabulary.morphologyNote: sample + -ing，表示抽样这一过程。

vocabulary.name: defect rate
vocabulary.example: Record the defect rate for each batch.
vocabulary.translation: 记录每个批次的缺陷率。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: defect（缺陷）+ rate（比率）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: defect 可指裂果、软果等不合格缺陷。

vocabulary.name: traceability
vocabulary.example: Keep the records for product traceability.
vocabulary.translation: 保留记录以确保产品可追溯。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: trace（追踪）+ -able（能够）+ -ity（性质）；traceable → traceability。
vocabulary.memoryHint: trace = 追踪；traceable = 可追溯的。

vocabulary.name: residue
vocabulary.example: The fruit must meet the pesticide residue requirements.
vocabulary.translation: 果实必须符合农药残留要求。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 整体记忆；pesticide residue = 农药残留。
vocabulary.memoryHint: 涉及限量标准时应以适用法规/客户标准为准。

vocabulary.name: batch
vocabulary.example: Record the batch number on the label.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: 基础词，整体记忆。

vocabulary.name: compliance
vocabulary.example: The farm must maintain food safety compliance.
vocabulary.translation: 农场必须保持食品安全合规。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: comply（遵守/符合）+ -ance（名词后缀）。

vocabulary.name: food safety
vocabulary.example: All workers must follow food safety rules.
vocabulary.translation: 所有工人必须遵守食品安全规定。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: food（食品）+ safety（安全；safe + -ty）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: food safety rules = 食品安全规则。

vocabulary.name: root system
vocabulary.example: Check the root system for signs of damage.
vocabulary.translation: 检查根系是否有受损迹象。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: root（根）+ system（系统）。

vocabulary.name: shoot growth
vocabulary.morphologyNote: shoot（新梢/枝条）+ growth（生长；grow + -th）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: growth 是 grow 的名词形式。

vocabulary.name: flower bud
vocabulary.example: Count the flower buds on selected plants.
vocabulary.translation: 统计抽样植株上的花芽数量。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: flower（花）+ bud（芽）。

vocabulary.name: fruit set
vocabulary.example: Poor fruit set may reduce yield.
vocabulary.translation: 坐果不良可能降低产量。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: fruit（果实）+ set（形成/坐住）；园艺固定表达。
vocabulary.memoryHint: fruit set 指开花后幼果形成并稳定的过程。

vocabulary.name: fruit development
vocabulary.morphologyNote: develop（发育）+ -ment（名词后缀）。

vocabulary.name: substrate moisture
vocabulary.translation: 灌溉前检查基质含水量。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: substrate（基质）+ moisture（湿度/含水状态）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: moist = 潮湿的；moisture = 水分/湿度。

vocabulary.name: plant vigor
vocabulary.translation: 不同区块的植株长势不同。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: plant（植株）+ vigor（活力/长势）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: vigor 也可写作 vigour（英式拼写）。

vocabulary.name: drainage percentage
vocabulary.example: Record the drainage percentage for each valve.
vocabulary.translation: 记录每个阀门的尾水率。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: drainage（排水）+ percentage（百分比）。

vocabulary.name: irrigation uniformity
vocabulary.example: We need to improve irrigation uniformity.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要提高灌溉均匀度。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: irrigation + uniform（均匀）+ -ity（性质）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: uniformity 是 uniform 的名词。

vocabulary.name: fertilizer solution
vocabulary.morphologyNote: fertilize（施肥）+ -er（物质/工具）；solution（溶液）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: fertilizer 是肥料；fertilize 是施肥。

vocabulary.name: stock solution
vocabulary.example: Prepare the stock solution according to the recipe.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: stock（储备/浓缩原液）+ solution（溶液）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: stock solution 常用于施肥母液。

vocabulary.name: nutrient deficiency
vocabulary.example: Check the leaves for signs of nutrient deficiency.
vocabulary.translation: 检查叶片是否有营养缺乏的迹象。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: nutrient（营养元素）+ deficiency（缺乏；deficient + -cy）。

vocabulary.name: productivity
vocabulary.example: We need to improve labor productivity.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要提高劳动生产率。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: productive（有生产力的）+ -ity（性质/状态）；与 produce 同词族。
vocabulary.memoryHint: productivity 不等于 production（产量/生产）。

vocabulary.name: labor cost
vocabulary.morphologyNote: labor（人工）+ cost（成本）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: cost per unit = 单位成本。

vocabulary.name: work efficiency
vocabulary.example: We review work efficiency every week.
vocabulary.translation: 我们每周复核工作效率。
vocabulary.morphologyNote: efficient（高效的）+ -cy（名词后缀）形成 efficiency。

vocabulary.name: production forecast
vocabulary.example: Update the production forecast every week.
vocabulary.morphologyNote: production（产量/生产）+ forecast（预测）。

vocabulary.name: performance
vocabulary.morphologyNote: perform（执行/表现）+ -ance（名词后缀）。
vocabulary.memoryHint: performance 可指设备表现或人员绩效。

sentences.text: Please check the drip emitters in Tunnel Two.
sentences.translation: 请检查二号棚的滴头。

sentences.text: Two workers will spray, and one will repair the plastic film.
sentences.translation: 两人点喷，一人修棚膜。

sentences.text: Finish the filter cleaning before lunch.
sentences.translation: 午饭前完成过滤器清洗。

sentences.text: Please take before-and-after photos.
sentences.translation: 请拍摄工作前后照片。

sentences.text: If you find a leak, mark the location and report it.
sentences.translation: 如果发现漏水，标记位置并报告。

sentences.text: Do not start the machine until it has been inspected.
sentences.translation: 检查完成前不要启动机器。

sentences.text: Let me know when the task is finished.
sentences.translation: 完成任务时告诉我。

sentences.text: Record the actual time you spent on each task.
sentences.translation: 记录每项工作的实际耗时。

sentences.text: Do not record the same hours under two categories.
sentences.translation: 不要将相同工时填入两个类别。

sentences.text: Wear the required protective equipment before spraying.
sentences.translation: 喷药前穿戴规定防护用品。

sentences.text: What problem did you find during the inspection?
sentences.translation: 巡检时发现了什么问题？

sentences.text: Show me which valves have low pressure.
sentences.translation: 告诉我哪些阀门压力低。

sentences.text: Could you help me check the pressure at the far end?
sentences.translation: 能帮我检查远端压力吗？

sentences.text: The pressure dropped after we cleaned the filter.
sentences.translation: 清洗过滤器后压力下降了。

sentences.text: We need to determine whether the problem is in the pump or the pipe.
sentences.translation: 需要判断问题在水泵还是管道。

sentences.text: I have uploaded the inspection photos to the maintenance form.
sentences.translation: 我已经把巡检照片上传到维护表单。

sentences.text: Please confirm who is responsible for this repair.
sentences.translation: 请确认谁负责这项维修。

sentences.text: The valve sometimes clicks but does not open.
sentences.translation: 电磁阀有时咔哒响但打不开。

sentences.text: Can we split the work according to the actual tasks performed?
sentences.translation: 能否按实际完成的工作拆分工时？

sentences.text: The uniformity test is scheduled for Wednesday.
sentences.translation: 均匀度测定安排在周三。

sentences.text: Which work category should we use for this task?
sentences.translation: 这项工作应该使用哪个工时类别？

sentences.text: The current guideline does not clearly cover this activity.
sentences.translation: 现行规范没有明确涵盖这项活动。

sentences.text: Could you confirm the correct classification in writing?
sentences.translation: 能否书面确认正确的分类？

sentences.text: We should not create a new category without approval.
sentences.translation: 未经批准不应自创工时类别。

sentences.text: This task involves both inspection and repair, so the hours should be separated.
sentences.translation: 这项工作包括检查和维修，因此工时应拆分。

sentences.text: Please clarify whether routine checks count as maintenance hours.
sentences.translation: 请明确例行检查是否计入维护工时。

sentences.text: Could you clarify which department is responsible for this process?
sentences.translation: 能否明确哪个部门负责这个流程？

sentences.text: Our production team can verify the work, but HR should clarify the reporting rules.
sentences.translation: 生产团队可以核实工作，但人事应明确填报规则。

sentences.text: We need a consistent standard across all farms.
sentences.translation: 我们需要所有农场统一的标准。

sentences.text: Please share the updated policy with the farm teams.
sentences.translation: 请将更新后的政策同步给各农场团队。

sentences.text: We completed the filter cleaning, but the pressure is still below target.
sentences.translation: 过滤器已清洗，但压力仍低于目标。

sentences.text: Five workers are available today, and I have assigned them by priority.
sentences.translation: 今天有五名工人，我已按优先级分工。

sentences.text: The repair is delayed because we are waiting for replacement parts.
sentences.translation: 维修延迟，因为我们在等备件。

sentences.text: I recommend checking the pipeline before replacing the pump.
sentences.translation: 建议先检查管道再更换水泵。

sentences.text: We found several blocked emitters during the inspection.
sentences.translation: 巡检发现多个堵塞滴头。

sentences.text: I have attached photos so that you can review the results.
sentences.translation: 我附上了照片，方便您查看结果。

sentences.text: We may need one additional worker to complete the maintenance on time.
sentences.translation: 可能需要再增加一名工人才能按时完成维护。

sentences.text: If we delay this repair, irrigation uniformity may be affected.
sentences.translation: 如果推迟维修，灌溉均匀度可能受影响。

sentences.text: Could you approve the proposed work schedule?
sentences.translation: 能否批准拟定工作计划？

sentences.text: The current piece rate should be reviewed based on actual productivity.
sentences.translation: 当前计件单价应根据实际效率复核。

sentences.text: To avoid confusion, we need a clear division of responsibilities.
sentences.translation: 为了避免混乱，需要明确职责分工。

sentences.text: I can provide the field records, but I cannot approve the HR policy.
sentences.translation: 我可以提供现场记录，但不能审批人事政策。

sentences.text: Please let us know if any supporting documents are required.
sentences.translation: 如果需要任何佐证文件，请告知我们。

sentences.text: We need to agree on the process before implementing it.
sentences.translation: 执行之前需要就流程达成一致。

sentences.text: The purpose of this form is to make maintenance work traceable.
sentences.translation: 这张表的目的是让维护工作可追溯。

sentences.text: The total yield increased by 8% compared with last season.
sentences.translation: 总产量比上一季增加了8%。

sentences.text: The yield per hectare was lower than expected.
sentences.translation: 每公顷单产低于预期。
sentences.grammar: yield per hectare; lower than expected

sentences.text: The harvest peak is expected next week.
sentences.translation: 预计下周进入采收高峰。

sentences.text: Please record the harvest volume by variety and date.
sentences.translation: 请按品种和日期记录采收量。

sentences.text: Please separate soft or damaged berries during picking.
sentences.translation: 采摘时请分开软果和损伤果。

sentences.text: We need to check fruit firmness and Brix.
sentences.translation: 我们需要检查果实硬度和糖度。

sentences.text: The berries should have good color and an even bloom.
sentences.translation: 蓝莓应具有良好颜色和均匀果粉。

sentences.text: Please take a representative sample from each batch.
sentences.translation: 请从每个批次抽取有代表性的样品。

sentences.text: Record the defect rate for each variety.
sentences.translation: 记录每个品种的缺陷率。

sentences.text: Keep the spray records for traceability.
sentences.translation: 保留施药记录以便追溯。

sentences.text: Make sure the pesticide application follows the approved procedure.
sentences.translation: 确保施药按照批准的程序执行。

sentences.text: We found signs of nutrient deficiency on some leaves.
sentences.translation: 我们在部分叶片上发现营养缺乏的迹象。

sentences.text: Please record shoot growth by variety.
sentences.translation: 请按品种记录新梢生长。

sentences.text: The drainage percentage was lower than the target.
sentences.translation: 尾水率低于目标值。

sentences.text: We adjusted the irrigation schedule based on the substrate moisture.
sentences.translation: 我们根据基质含水量调整了灌溉计划。

sentences.text: Please check the EC and pH of the nutrient solution.
sentences.translation: 请检查营养液的EC和pH。

sentences.text: We need to improve labor productivity during peak harvest.
sentences.translation: 采收高峰期我们需要提高劳动生产率。

sentences.text: Please update the production forecast every Monday.
sentences.translation: 请每周一更新产量预测。

sentences.text: The labor cost per kilogram increased this week.
sentences.translation: 本周每公斤人工成本上升了。

guidance.title: 来源与边界
guidance.text: 词汇参照此前《工时填写规范》整理出的工时分类原文索引，包含农机维护、灌溉系统维护等；并补充实际农场英语。

guidance.title: 原表用语
guidance.text: 原表包含 Lawn mower inspection and repair、Sprayer inspection and repair、Filter cleaning、Pipeline flushing、Uniformity check 等。

guidance.title: 表达区别
guidance.text: 原表英文是工作分类标签，句库是为实际交流补写的自然英语，不应当作公司已批准的工时分类。

guidance.title: 使用建议
guidance.text: 每天先背10个词，选工人/同事/人事/领导各一句，替换设备名和工作地点练习。

guidance.title: 特别提醒
guidance.text: 计件价格、工时核定、岗位职责属于公司内部规则，句子仅用于沟通，不代表政策结论。

morphologyGuide.note: spect 看到“看”，inspect 是仔细查看；inspection 是检查这件事。

morphologyGuide.meaning: 常把动词变成名词，表示动作/过程/结果
morphologyGuide.note: 先找熟悉的动词，再记名词形式；不是所有 -tion 都能机械套用。

morphologyGuide.meaning: 常形成名词，表示状态、行为或性质
常形成表示性质/状态的名词
可表示做某动作的人或工具
否定或反向，常表示去除/相反动作
morphologyGuide.note: clog 是堵塞；unclog 是疏通。
refuel=重新加燃料；revise=重新审视后修改。
micro 表示微小，micro tubing 是细毛管。
-cide 常见于表示杀灭的词，如 pesticide（杀虫/害物药剂）；需按专业语境理解。

morphologyGuide.meaning: 动词变名词，表示过程/结果
morphologyGuide.note: grow 是生长；growth 是生长/增长。

morphologyGuide.meaning: 形容词变名词，表示性质/状态
morphologyGuide.note: firm 是坚实的；firmness 是硬度/坚实度。

morphologyGuide.form: 并非所有单词都能拆词根
morphologyGuide.meaning: 对来源复杂或现代英语中不透明的词，标注“整体记忆”，避免编造词源。
morphologyGuide.note: 优先记发音、拼写、搭配和工作场景。

morphologyGuide.meaning: 本文件用近似音节/重音提示辅助，不替代标准音标或真人发音。
morphologyGuide.note: 可以先听音、再拼写、最后放进句子。
